stem: Why was the victory at Saratoga a turning point in U.S. history?

options.label: A
options.text: It convinced France to support the American cause.

options.label: B
options.text: The battle led to the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

options.label: C
options.text: The battle represented the end of the American Revolution.

options.label: D
options.text: It marked a major change in the leadership of the Continental Army.
